name: My question bank
description: Template: one example of each question type. Files starting with _ are not loaded by the game.

questions.question: What is the Mr of H2O?
questions.explanation: 2(1) + 16 = 18. 'answer' is the 0-based index of the correct option.

questions.question: Which of these molecules are polar? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: 'answer' lists every correct 0-based index. H₂O and NH₃ are polar; CO₂ and CH₄ are symmetrical.

questions.question: What is the concentration of a solution with 0.02 mol of HCl in 250 cm3?
questions.explanation: 0.02 ÷ 0.250 = 0.08 mol L⁻¹. 'tolerance' is absolute; leave it out to allow 1%.

questions.question: Name the gas produced when ethanol is dehydrated over Al2O3.
questions.explanation: List every acceptable answer. Comparison ignores spaces and case (set "caseSensitive": true for formulas like Co vs CO).

questions.question: Order these by increasing electronegativity.
questions.explanation: Write the items in the CORRECT order; the game shuffles them.

questions.question: Match each stage of water treatment to its purpose.
questions.explanation: Write correct [left, right] pairs; the game shuffles the right-hand column.
